schema:
title-format: "# <!--[DEMO]--> Demo Document"
section-types:
  ttl:
    prefix: TTL
  item:
    prefix: items_
    subsection-types:
      sts:
        max-count: 1
  items:
    prefix: items
    subsection-types:
      item:
        min-count: 1
        max-count: infinite
  sts:
    prefix: STS
    max-text-length: 4
document:
  sections:
    ttl:
      section-type: ttl
      optional: true
    items:
      section-type: items
      optional: true
